title: PAYE tax code meanings and 2026 to 2027 flat rates - GOV.UK

content.p: Code meanings checked against HMRC tax-code guidance; percentages checked against the employer rates for 2026 to 2027.

model_notes: Unprefixed BR is accepted as basic-rate shorthand in each selected region.
Other unprefixed non-basic flat codes use England/Wales meanings; Scotland requires SD0 to SD3.
Jurisdiction prefixes on allowance codes must match the selected region. Emergency-code suffixes and obsolete Y codes are not modeled.
